templates.name: funds/harbourline-global-value/templates/custodian-positions
templates.form:
template custodian-positions {
  reads      csv with header
  grain      one position per row

  entity     holding  (instrument)
    by     isin   from "ISIN"
    or     ticker from "Ticker" within exchange from "Exch"
    absent   pend

  fact       position
    reference    from "LineRef"
    holding      holding
    asOf         from "AsOf" as date "YYYY-MM-DD"
    quantity     from "Quantity" as decimal
    marketValue  from "MarketValue" as money in "Ccy"

  posts      nothing — reference data, recorded and never booked
}

templates.name: funds/harbourline-global-value/templates/prime_equity_trades
templates.form:
template prime_equity_trades {
  reads      csv with header
  grain      one trade per row

  entity     security  (instrument)
    by     isin   from "ISIN"
    or     ticker from "Symbol" within exchange from "Exch"
    absent   pend

  entity     broker  (counterparty)
    by     code   from "Broker"
    absent   pend

  fact       trade
    reference    from "TradeRef"
    broker       broker
    security     security
    side         from "B/S" as { B: buy, S: sell }
    quantity     from "Quantity" as decimal
    price        from "Price" as money in "Ccy"
    traded       from "TradeDate" as date "MM/DD/YYYY"

  posts      by "side"
    amount      consideration
    dated       traded
    buy         -> equity_purchase
    sell        -> disposal_proceeds
}

templates.name: funds/harbourline-global-value/templates/capital-calls
templates.form:
template capital-calls {
  reads      csv with header
  grain      one capital per row

  fact       capital
    reference   from "CallRef"
    dated       from "Date" as date "YYYY-MM-DD"
    amount      from "Amount" as money in "Ccy"
    kind        from "Kind" as { call_gp: call_gp, call_lp: call_lp, commit_gp: commit_gp, commit_lp: commit_lp }

  posts      by "kind"
    amount      amount
    dated       dated
    call_gp     -> call_gp
    call_lp     -> call_lp
    commit_gp   -> commit_gp
    commit_lp   -> commit_lp
}

templates.name: funds/harbourline-global-value/templates/subscriptions
templates.form:
template subscriptions {
  reads      csv with header
  grain      one capital per row

  fact       capital
    reference   from "Ref"
    dated       from "Date" as date "YYYY-MM-DD"
    amount      from "Amount" as money in "Ccy"
    quantity    from "Quantity" as decimal
    kind        from "Kind" as { redeem: redeem, redeem_gp: redeem_gp, redeem_lp: redeem_lp, subscribe: subscribe, subscribe_gp: subscribe_gp, subscribe_lp: subscribe_lp }

  posts      by "kind"
    amount      amount
    dated       dated
    redeem      -> redeem
    redeem_gp   -> redeem_gp
    redeem_lp   -> redeem_lp
    subscribe   -> subscribe
    subscribe_gp-> subscribe_gp
    subscribe_lp-> subscribe_lp

templates.name: funds/household/templates/bank-statement
templates.form:
template bank-statement {
  reads      csv with header
  grain      one statement per row

  entity     payee  (counterparty)
    by     name   from "Memo"
    absent   pend

  fact       statement
    reference    from "Ref"
    payee        payee
    dated        from "Date" as date "MM/DD/YYYY"
    amount       from "Amount" as money in "Ccy"
    memo         from "Memo" as text
    account      from "Account" as text
    kind         from "Kind" as { card: card, expense: expense, income: income }

  posts      by "kind"
    amount      amount
    dated       dated
    card        -> card_charge
    expense     -> living_expense
    income      -> household_income
}

templates.name: funds/household/templates/loan-payment
templates.form:
template loan-payment {
  reads      csv with header
  grain      one payment per row

  entity     lender  (counterparty)
    by     name   from "Lender"
    absent   pend

  fact       payment
    reference    from "Ref"
    lender       lender
    dated        from "Date" as date "YYYY-MM-DD"
    principal    from "Principal" as money in "Ccy"
    interest     from "Interest" as money in "Ccy" optional
    loan         from "Loan" as { auto: auto, mortgage: mortgage, student: student }
    memo         from "Memo" as text optional

  posts      by "loan"
    amount      principal
    dated       dated
    auto        -> auto_principal
    mortgage    -> mortgage_principal
    student     -> student_principal
    also        interest
      auto      -> auto_interest
      mortgage  -> mortgage_interest
      student   -> student_interest
}

templates.name: funds/bridge/templates/project-invoices
templates.form:
template project-invoices {
  reads      csv with header
  grain      one invoice per row

  entity     vendor  (counterparty)
    by     name   from "Vendor"
    absent   pend

  fact       invoice
    reference   from "InvoiceRef"
    vendor      vendor
    dated       from "Date" as date "YYYY-MM-DD"
    amount      from "Amount" as money in "Ccy"
    memo        from "Memo" as text optional
    kind        from "Kind" as { cost: cost, cost_finishes: cost_finishes, cost_site: cost_site, cost_structure: cost_structure, earn_progress: earn_progress, invoice: invoice, invoice_finishes: invoice_finishes, invoice_site: invoice_site, invoice_structure: invoice_structure, pay_vendor: pay_vendor, progress_bill: progress_bill }

  posts      by "kind"
    amount      amount
    dated       dated
    cost        -> project_cost
    cost_finishes-> project_cost_finishes
    cost_site   -> project_cost_site
    cost_structure-> project_cost_structure
    earn_progress-> earn_progress
    invoice     -> vendor_invoice
    invoice_finishes-> vendor_invoice_finishes
    invoice_site-> vendor_invoice_site
    invoice_structure-> vendor_invoice_structure
    pay_vendor  -> pay_vendor
    progress_bill-> progress_bill
}
